hook: Some tumor helper T cells are ex-regulatory cells that keep suppressing immunity, in mice.
hook_turn: that keep suppressing immunity, in mice.
summary: KLRG1-positive helper T cells in mouse tumors and human kidney cancer look like regulatory T cells and suppress immune responses, and fate mapping showed some descend from regulatory cells that lost FoxP3. Depleting KLRG1 cells with an antibody slowed tumor growth more than blocking KLRG1. The fate mapping and treatment data are from mice, and the human data are descriptive.
title: Cytotoxic CD4+ exTregs expressing KLRG1 retain immunosuppressive function in cancer
